note: Machine-readable licence gate for the two shipping runtime closures. scripts/audit-sbom.mjs classifies every component's resolved licence (license-overlay.json takes precedence over license-index.json); a copyleft or commercial match that is NOT in dispositionedBaseline fails `pnpm audit:sbom:check`. This is the non-vacuous half of the M0.5 closure contract.
policy: Apache-2.0 is the governing project licence (see LICENSE, NOTICE). Permissive licences (MIT, ISC, BSD, Apache-2.0, BlueOak, 0BSD, MIT-0, CC0, Unlicense, Python-2.0) are allowed in shipping runtime closures without disposition. Copyleft (GPL/LGPL/AGPL/MPL/EPL/CDDL/OSL/EUPL/SSPL/CC-BY-SA) and commercial / no-grant strings (SEE LICENSE IN…, UNLICENSED, proprietary, commercial) require an explicit, reasoned disposition here before they may ship.

forbiddenPatterns.reason: Copyleft / reciprocal terms — legal review required before shipping in an Apache-2.0 product.
Commercial or unresolved 'see the bundled file' grant — obligation cannot be discharged from an SBOM and may be non-redistributable.

dispositionedBaseline.reason: GPL-2.0 at this exact version (package 'latest' is MIT). Chain: root dependencies['@changesets/cli'] -> tty-table -> smartwrap -> breakword@1.0.5, reaching the webapp runner via Dockerfile.platos COPY of the root manifest.
dispositionedBaseline.remediation: Preferred: move @changesets/cli (release tooling) from root `dependencies` to `devDependencies` so it never enters a runtime image. Cheap alternative: add pnpm.overrides['breakword']='^1.0.6' (1.0.6 is MIT). Either requires a lockfile regeneration (relock), which is out of scope for a no-install audit; tracked as M0.5 unresolved item #3.

dispositionedBaseline.reason: Proprietary browser-fingerprinting SDK, undeclared, pulled by @kapaai/react-sdk@0.1.3 -> @fingerprintjs/fingerprintjs-pro-react (which is also on the pnpm onlyBuiltDependencies install-script allowlist). @kapaai/react-sdk is referenced nowhere in the repo.
dispositionedBaseline.remediation: Remove @kapaai/react-sdk from apps/webapp/package.json (recommended) — deletes a commercial licence obligation, an install-script grant and a fingerprinting library from an OSS product in one edit. Requires a relock. Tracked as M0.5 unresolved item #7. If retained, a commercial licence agreement must be produced.

dispositionedBaseline.reason: The locked version's `license` field is the string 'SEE LICENSE IN LICENSE'; the package-level field is the true '(Apache-2.0 AND MIT)'. posthog-js is genuinely OSS — the version metadata is mislabelled, not a real commercial grant. It is nonetheless a repo-wide orphan (referenced nowhere in the webapp source).
dispositionedBaseline.remediation: Remove with the 126-package webapp orphan cleanup (M0.5 §5.2 preconditions). Requires a relock. Benign either way — retained here only so the gate stays honest about the literal published string.
